name: hornero
description: Role-and-skill methodology for Claude Code: PM reviewer subagent, 12 slash commands, and 51 expert-grounded skills (37 product-management skills + 14 cross-role process skills, three of them — hypothesis-track, stakeholder-update, customer-update — driving the chronicle layer's append exception). Role-and-skill methodology for Claude Code: PM reviewer subagent, 10 slash commands, and 50 expert-grounded skills (37 product-management skills + 13 cross-role process skills, including the cross-system `query-issue-tracker` (Linear/Jira) and `query-warehouse` (BigQuery/Snowflake) read primitives). Per-role skills are exposed at the plugin-loader's flat `skills/<name>` layout via build-time symlinks. The optional `mcpServers` block below lists data sources Hornero skills opt into via `resources:` frontmatter — every entry is `optional: true`; Hornero stays usable when nothing is configured.

linear.description: Issue tracker for product engineering. See resources/linear/RESOURCE.md.

jira.description: Atlassian's issue tracker. See resources/jira/RESOURCE.md for the OAuth (Atlassian Remote MCP) vs API-token (community server) paths.

github.description: Code host — PRs, issues, Actions, releases. See resources/github/RESOURCE.md.

bigquery.description: Google's serverless analytics warehouse. See resources/bigquery/RESOURCE.md.

snowflake.description: Snowflake's cloud data warehouse. See resources/snowflake/RESOURCE.md.

hubspot.description: HubSpot CRM — Contacts, Companies, Deals, Tickets, Pipelines. See resources/hubspot/RESOURCE.md.
